versions.changelog: Fix code review issues: Xero category mismatch, remove emoji from templates, allow empty receipts, fix tax year label format, add JSON error handling
Fix README: remove auto-install claim, add Privacy section, clarify vision/OCR processing
Fix security warnings: consistent paths, remove auto-install behavior
Add usage guide, NZ GST filing schedule, full English README, IRD GST101A box corrections

Initial release of kiwi-receipts skill:

- Processes receipt and invoice photos into IRD-compliant GST reports for NZ businesses.
- Extracts structured data from receipt images and accumulates them into a local JSON database.
- Supports setup of business name and GST number; handles confirmation and correction before saving data.
- Provides commands for summary, report generation (XLSX), listing, deleting, and exporting receipts.
- Complies with NZ IRD GST legislation and record-keeping requirements.
- Triggers on receipt/invoice images and relevant text commands in English and Chinese.
